disposition: Full, incremental, and snapshot backup kinds are implemented with content-derived manifests binding ordered names/lengths/SHA-256 digests, fail-closed chain verification (missing/reordered/truncated/corrupt links reject before any target), caller-pinned snapshot boundaries restored as-of that boundary, idempotent reruns, and bounded progress/skipped-item disclosure — all exercised by focused passing tests over local archives; per-kind encryption/compression lives at the scheduled-bundle layer (PB-6013) and provider destinations are PB-6012's gap, and no cloud/qualification claim is made.
